tagline: Nordic leader investing in social infrastructure through core holdings in residential and community properties
hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI reflects exposure to the real estate portfolio, the primary value driver for SBB, with increasing concentration on key assets in Nordic social infrastructure.

kpis.name: Real Estate Exposure
kpis.explanation: Total value of real estate assets held directly or through participations.
kpis.description: Real estate exposure increased from 2.8 billion SEK to 78.7 billion SEK in the first quarter of 2026, driven by acquisitions in key assets.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value (NAV)
kpis.explanation: Net enterprise value after debt, adjusted on a long-term basis.
kpis.description: Substansvärde increased to 14,528 MSEK at end of March 2026, compared to 14,386 MSEK at end of 2025, representing +142 MSEK.

kpis.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio
kpis.explanation: Long-term debt divided by asset value.
kpis.description: Belåningsgrad improved from 60% to 53% between March 2025 and March 2026, demonstrating improved financial health.

kpis.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
kpis.explanation: Earnings capacity to cover interest charges.
kpis.description: The ratio improved from 1.8 to 2.2 between March 2025 and March 2026, indicating stronger interest coverage.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Earnings before exceptional items and taxes.
kpis.description: Driftnettot reached 254 MSEK in Q1 2026, up 3.9% on a comparable basis.

kpis.name: Rental Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from real estate leases.
kpis.description: Hyresintäkter reached 474 MSEK in Q1 2026, of which 398 MSEK originated from Sveafastigheter.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value (NAV)
kpis.explanation: Net enterprise value after debt, adjusted on a long-term basis.
kpis.description: Substansvärde was 14,386 MSEK at end of 2025, showing a slight increase compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio
kpis.explanation: Long-term debt divided by asset value.
kpis.description: Belåningsgrad was 50% at end of 2025, down from 60% one year earlier.

risks.title: Rental income concentration and tenant dependence
risks.score_rationale: Core business risk for a Nordic real estate manager. The document shows strong exposure to rental revenues (hyresintäkter) with variable economic occupancy rates: 66.5% for SBB Development versus 95.5% for Sveafastigheter. Measured language but financial data reveals significant revenue volatility.

risks.title: Real estate portfolio valuation decline risk
risks.score_rationale: Massive exposure to real estate values: 78.6 billion SEK in total exposure. The document details market value metrics and driftnetto with normalized adjustments, indicating valuation volatility. Downward trend evident: 16.8 billion SEK reduction in exposure between 2025-2026.

risks.title: Liquidity and debt refinancing risk
risks.score_rationale: Significant debt load: 38.2 billion SEK with interest coverage ratio of 2.2x. Belåningsgrad at 53% and net debt of 35.9 billion SEK. Technical language but figures reveal dependence on refinancing markets and limited debt service capacity.

risks.title: Asset and project quality deterioration risk
risks.score_rationale: Portfolio includes 5.8 billion SEK in projects and development rights with normalized driftnetto adjusted by 217 MSEK. SBB Development segment shows low occupancy: 66.5%. Neutral language but structure reveals risk of unprofitable projects.

risks.title: Geographic concentration risk in Scandinavia
risks.score_rationale: Concentration in Sweden and Norway via Sveafastigheter: 1.7 billion SEK in revenue and Public Property Invest: 40.6% ownership stake. No geographic diversification mentioned. Trend stable but structural risk from regional dependence.

risks.title: Shareholder dilution and complex capital structure risk
risks.score_rationale: Complex structure with Class A, B, D shares and hybrid bonds. Negative earnings per share: -0.59 SEK Q1 2026. Significant minorities: 10.9 billion SEK and unconsolidated participations: Nordiqus 49.84%, PPI 40.63%. Technical language reveals governance complexity.

risks.title: Operating performance and declining profitability risk
risks.score_rationale: Negative ROE: -5% annualized Q1 2026 versus +49% Q1 2025. Net result: -154 MSEK Q1 2026. Driftnetto decline: 1.2 billion SEK versus 2.3 billion SEK. Neutral language but figures reveal significant profitability deterioration.

risks.title: Joint venture and minority interest dependence risk
risks.score_rationale: Significant exposure through JVs/minority interests: Nordiqus 49.84%, Public Property Invest 40.63%, Sveafastigheter 100% with 5.6 billion SEK minorities. JV result volatility: 446 MSEK versus -406 MSEK. Technical language but structure reveals governance risk.
